#compdef my-app
###-begin-my-app-completions-###
#
# Static completion script for Zsh
#
# Installation:
#   my-app --completions zsh > ~/.zsh/completions/_my-app
#   then add ~/.zsh/completions to your fpath
#

_my_app() {
  local context state state_descr line
  typeset -A opt_args

  local -a commands
  commands=(
    'remote:Manage remotes\: add]'
    'rm:Manage remotes\: add]'
  )

  local -a specs
  specs=(
    '(--verbose -v --no-verbose)--verbose[Be loud\: '\''very'\'' [x\] \\ café 😀]'
    '(--verbose -v --no-verbose)-v[Be loud\: '\''very'\'' [x\] \\ café 😀]'
    '(--verbose -v --no-verbose)--no-verbose[Disable verbose]'
    '(--color -c --colour)--color:value:(auto never x\:y)'
    '(--color -c --colour)-c:value:(auto never x\:y)'
    '(--color -c --colour)--colour:value:(auto never x\:y)'
    '(--config)--config[Config file]:file:_files'
    '(--log)--log=-[Log level]::value:'
    '(--count)--count:integer:'
    -
    parent-arguments
    ':Input path:_files'
    '*:rest:(one two)'
    -
    subcommands
    '1:command:->command'
    '*::arg:->args'
  )

  _arguments -C "${specs[@]}"

  case "$state" in
    command)
      _describe -t commands 'commands' commands
      ;;
    args)
      case "$words[1]" in
        remote)
          _my_app_remote
          ;;
        rm)
          _my_app_rm
          ;;
      esac
      ;;
  esac
}

_my_app_remote() {
  local context state state_descr line
  typeset -A opt_args

  local -a commands
  commands=(
    'deploy:Deploy it'
  )

  local -a specs
  specs=(
    '1:command:->command'
    '*::arg:->args'
  )

  _arguments -C "${specs[@]}"

  case "$state" in
    command)
      _describe -t commands 'commands' commands
      ;;
    args)
      case "$words[1]" in
        deploy)
          _my_app_remote_deploy
          ;;
      esac
      ;;
  esac
}

_my_app_remote_deploy() {
  local -a specs
  specs=(
    '(--env)--env:value:(prod it\'\''s\ \"qa\" a\ b)'
    ':target:_directories'
  )
  _arguments "${specs[@]}"
}

_my_app_rm() {
  local context state state_descr line
  typeset -A opt_args

  local -a commands
  commands=(
    'deploy:Deploy it'
  )

  local -a specs
  specs=(
    '1:command:->command'
    '*::arg:->args'
  )

  _arguments -C "${specs[@]}"

  case "$state" in
    command)
      _describe -t commands 'commands' commands
      ;;
    args)
      case "$words[1]" in
        deploy)
          _my_app_rm_deploy
          ;;
      esac
      ;;
  esac
}

_my_app_rm_deploy() {
  local -a specs
  specs=(
    '(--env)--env:value:(prod it\'\''s\ \"qa\" a\ b)'
    ':target:_directories'
  )
  _arguments "${specs[@]}"
}

# Handle both direct invocation and autoload
if [[ "${zsh_eval_context[-1]}" == "loadautofunc" ]]; then
  _my_app "$@"
else
  compdef _my_app my-app
fi
###-end-my-app-completions-###
